integrity: The infinite statement is supported by a direct proof. Computation is reported only as a finite stress test. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers connected noncomplete threshold graphs whose canonical zero-blocks are all singletons; it does not enumerate nonmaximum failed sets. Exhaustive computation checks orders at most 11 only. The full text of the 2016 foundational failed-skew article was not inspectable from the lawful sources available, so a residual bibliographic-overlap risk remains.
title: Failed skew zero forcing at the false-twin-free boundary of threshold graphs
